Subject: MAP sprint review — Week 3 status & owners

Hi Bryan —

Quick weekly touch on the mutual action plan (attached MAP_Acme_v1.3.xlsx) and the acceptance checklist (attached pdf). Goals for this note: 1) snapshot where we stand vs the trial acceptance criteria, 2) list current blockers and owners, and 3) confirm the next run of acceptance tests on Tue 2026-09-21.

Status highlights (week-over-week):
- Infra: test cluster provisioned in us-west-2; baseline latency tests complete (see sheet "infra-bench").
- Model/eval: eval harness integrated with your sample prompts; initial MAP pass shows 88% on our quality gate (target 90% for acceptance).
- Security/compliance: we received your questionnaire but are missing a few clarifications (items 4, 7, 12 in the spreadsheet).

Current blockers and suggested owners:
- Security Q: Acme legal needs clarification on data residency language (owner: Acme Legal). ACTION: Redwood to propose specific residency phrasing by end of day Mon. (owner: Marissa)
- Entitlement mismatch: SSO config failing for one test user — blocks end-to-end acceptance tests. ACTION: Vivek to coordinate with Acme IT Ops and provide a patched SSO manifest.
- Eval gap: two prompts show hallucination patterns for domain-specific terms. ACTION: Priyom to run prompt refactor + rerun per checklist.

Acceptance test plan (Tue 2026-09-21):
- Scope: 3 flows (search-assist, doc-summarize, chat-support) per eval checklist; pass if all flows meet latency <250ms p95 and quality gate >=90%.
- Run owner: Marissa (or delegate) to kick off; Acme to provide two test accounts and confirm SSO before 08:30 PT.

Can you confirm the SSO owner and whether Legal wants us to propose alternate residency language? If we can close those by Monday EOD we should be green for Tue's test.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Marissa,

Thanks for the concise status. Quick answers:
- SSO owner: IT Ops (cc'd) — I'm assigning Priya Kumar to validate the manifest. Priya, can you look at Vivek's note and confirm by Monday?
- Legal: we reviewed the residency wording. Legal prefers: "Customer data processed and stored within the United States unless Customer opts into multi-region replication" — we'll accept your proposed wording but need a brief note on backup retention.

Blocker note: our security team flagged the eval harness's sample logging — they want assurance that raw user queries are not persisted in plain text beyond the 7-day debug window. Can you confirm Redwood's default retention and masking behavior? If needed legal will request minor contract clarifications before signature.

I'll be available for a 20-min sync Monday morning if helpful.

—Bryan
Bryan Hayes
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
bryan.hayes@acme.com

Thanks Bryan — noted on the logging retention ask. Quick responses and proposed owners: 

- Retention & masking: Redwood defaults to 7-day raw query retention for debug with automated masking enabled for PII; we can provide a technical note and redact config export for Legal. ACTION (Vivek): upload redaction config + retention policy doc to the shared Drive by EOD.
- SSO fix: Vivek -> will post a corrected SAML metadata packet to the Acme SSO test tenant tonight. Priya, please test and flag anything that fails — if not green we'll run a one-hour remediation window Mon 07:30-08:30 PT.
- Eval prompts: Priyom will push a revised prompt set (two alternatives per failing prompt) into the eval harness by Monday morning; we'll include expected outputs in the sheet.

PRIORY: get SSO green. If SSO isn't validated Mon morning we push acceptance tests to Wed and run a focused debug session Tue.

Vivek
